unit: active ensemble call (impact/secondary contact or any member breaking), >= 3 aligned members
per_call_rule: skill <= max(1.25, mean held-out member skill); skill floor = tolerance / 1.25
reference: each oracle member held out and scored against the others by the identical rule (leave-one-out bar)
family_accept: for every metric: one-sided 95% upper bootstrap bound of (member pass rate - model pass rate) <= 0.05 AND of (model mean skill/bar / member mean - 1) <= 0.05

uncertainty.confident: reported, not required: CI of each paired difference excludes the failing side

selection: validation dense score: CRPS ram / 0.05, 1-ARI vs every member / 0.05, W1 log mass vs every member / 0.1; mean over families + 0.25 * worst family

splits.confirm: calls-v3-eval test at the frozen tau (sweep informational)

reason: v1 compared point estimates (an oracle-equivalent model fails ~half the time); adopts P0's aggregate rule so per-call and closed-loop gates agree
